description: CRITICAL ISSUE RESOLUTION: Fixed infinite loop in staging-isolation-boundary.tsx that was causing React maximum update depth exceeded errors. Implemented comprehensive fixes for useEffect dependency chains that were triggering continuous validation-dispatch-render cycles. Optimized staging context reducer to prevent excessive audit events on every action dispatch. Resolved React anti-patterns, reduced security alert frequency, and improved performance with proper memoization patterns. Enhanced command pattern hook performance, fixed hydration mismatches, and improved timeout handling. All critical and major issues from console log analysis have been systematically resolved with staging environment now stable and functional.
